v01: This is version two of a contract. One number changed, on page four. Thirty days became ten. Most people miss it. That's the point.
v02: Sidebar. A second opinion on every contract, inside Jira.
v03: Sales sends Legal a cloud service agreement from Northwind, through Jira Service Management.
v04: Sidebar reads the contract against the company playbook in Confluence. Three clauses break it, and each comes with the exact wording to send back.
v04b: One click replies to the requester.
v05: Version two arrives. They fixed the liability cap. They did not fix the one-sided waiver.
v05b: And here is the one you were meant to miss. Thirty days became ten.
v06: What did we agree with Northwind before? Sidebar finds the earlier matter.
v06b: The same answers are in Rovo, through the Sidebar agent.
v07: Legal decides. Accepted clauses drop out. The requester gets one clean redline in the portal.
v08: The playbook is a normal Confluence page. Change it, and Sidebar changes with it.
v08b: Swap the playbook, and the same Sidebar reviews NDAs, purchase terms, offer letters, security questionnaires, vendor and partner deals.
